description: Source code for the AudioEqualizer class, implementing an audio equalizer with multiple filters, presets, and processing functions in the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: AudioEqualizer
classes.description: Class implementing an audio equalizer with multiple filter bands, presets, and processing capabilities.

methods.name: GetInstanceSize
methods.description: Calculates the memory size needed for an instance based on number of bands.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new AudioEqualizer instance, allocating memory if needed.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures filters with channel count and sample rate.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears filter states.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees allocated memory.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets filter parameters to default frequency ranges.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets gain for a specific band.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets center frequency for a specific band.

methods.name: setBandwidth
methods.description: Sets bandwidth for a peaking filter band.

methods.name: getGain
methods.description: Retrieves gain for a specific band.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves frequency for a specific band.

methods.name: getBandwidth
methods.description: Retrieves bandwidth for a peaking filter band.

methods.name: getBandRange
methods.description: Gets frequency range for a band.

methods.name: getPresetName
methods.description: Returns the name of a preset.

methods.name: getNumPresets
methods.description: Returns total number of presets.

methods.name: getPreset
methods.description: Returns current preset index.

methods.name: setPreset
methods.description: Applies a preset configuration.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits filter parameter changes.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes audio samples through the equalizer.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the equalizer filters.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the equalizer filters.

methods.name: getMostRelevantBand
methods.description: Finds the band closest to a target frequency.
